title: From fragments of thought to your own sentence
description: Short notes are assembled into a coherent version that can be checked and changed.

blocks.text: A person can know perfectly well what they want to say and still struggle with the form. In assembling it, their words and their emphases must not be lost.

quote.text: Since I had my aneurysm and two strokes my communication has been texting and I lost my ability to write and put sentences together so yes this app is very important to me

blocks.text: Keep the original pieces next to the suggestion. Support accessible reading, comparison and acceptance fragment by fragment.
Do not replace communication with guesses about intent. The user has to be able to reject the result and carry on with the input method available to them.
